reuse.why: Replaces the copied per-action queries with one getMonthWideBudgetCategories selection, and the new action reads the existing sum-amount sheet cell via getSheetValue; the #fixed match, though, is a custom regex instead of the shared/tags.ts tag parsing.

duplication.why: Category eligibility is decided once for every month-wide action; only the per-action income/tracking check (an existing pattern) is repeated, including in the new action.

placement.why: Selection and the fixed-group lookup sit in budget/actions.ts next to the actions and the new method is registered with its siblings; tag recognition would sit better with the shared tag helpers.

scope.why: Covers exactly the four requested steps: exclusions, the new action, #fixed groups and the includeHiddenCategories flag.

maintainability.why: A new exclusion or flag lands in one function with a documented parameter; the income rule outside it and the bespoke tag regex are the remaining rough edges.

bypasses_abstraction.where: FIXED_COST_TAG regex in budget/actions.ts parses note tags itself rather than using shared/tags.ts (extractTagsFromText).

disguised_duplication.where: Eligibility is shared; the income check repeats a pre-existing per-action pattern rather than disguising copied logic.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthWideBudgetCategories gains only the requested includeHiddenCategories parameter, applied uniformly in its query; every month-wide action, including copyPreviousMonth and setLastMonthSpending, selects through it.
